description: Identify an EVM 0x address (EIP-55 checksum, EOA vs contract/proxy/ERC20 on Eth/Base/BNB) or base58 32-byte Solana/X1 key size. $0.002 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

address.description: 0x EVM address or base58 key string

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

name: address_identify
title: Address identify
